title: Defect pair: a tape with at most one defect cannot halt, and 500,000 rounds followed
text: Lean proves that the token rules of the shared counter are deterministic and total on every tape with at most one defect, so a halt needs a defect that survives its round. A new engine followed every defect for 500,000 rounds (more than 2<sup>944,371</sup> steps); none survived. The top of the counter is explained by the conserved value 1/15 − (290/127)·2<sup>−k/2</sup> + …; only an irregular bottom layer of about 0.27 k digits is ever eaten.
